summary: First Busey Corporation filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a routine quarterly cash dividend on its 8.25% Fixed-Rate Series B Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. The dividend is $0.515625 per depositary share, payable September 1, 2026, to holders of record as of August 17, 2026. This is a standard dividend declaration by the issuer, not a special situation such as a capital return, tender, or restructuring. The filing contains no M&A, activist, or strategic activity. No deal terms are applicable. What to watch: nothing; this is an ordinary administrative event.
